lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular matrix of high-luminance circular pixel clusters (~5-10 pixels in diameter) arranged in at least four distinct longitudinal rows. The inter-centroid distance increases along the anterior-posterior axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a lattice where the blobs serve as primary nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running longitudinally across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high-intensity reflectance on the dorsal edge and a shadow-induced low-intensity region immediately ventral.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple high-contrast streamlined silhouettes exhibiting independent motion vectors relative to the subject, located near the ventral-pectoral junction (consistent with Echeneidae).
